overloads.semanticRole: The Type command returns a numeric value that indicates the type of field or variable you have passed in the fieldVar parameter.

constraints: Cannot be applied to scalar expressions such as object properties (emp.name) or collection elements (myColl[5]); use Value type for those.
In compiled mode, calling Type on a method parameter declared as variant returns the actual data type (same as Value type), not the Is variant constant.
